reason: I keep my phone within reach because of the kids and emergencies, so something that replaces it at the bedside solves a problem I don't have. I already have an alarm that works, even if I snooze it too much.
objection: The phone stays next to me anyway, so this would just be a second thing on the nightstand for 120 euros. I'm also wary of sleep and snoring estimates from a room sensor, since I already get better data from my watch.
would_change_my_mind: If it could reliably let urgent calls from the kids or family through without the phone being in the room, and cost around 70 euros.
